# Launches resolve through the emit map before any output exists (dist/main.js -> src/main.ts) and
# probe extensionless paths (src/main, src/sub/index.ts, dist/main -> dist/main.js -> src/main.ts).
# C-5: an extensionless path whose probed .js exists unindexed is not_indexed; nothing at all is
# not_found. (PoC schema2-launch: "launch targets resolve emitted paths before output exists".)
entrance	package.script	process	-	start	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	resolved	src/main.ts#	dist/main.js
entrance	package.script	process	-	direct	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	resolved	src/main.ts#	src/main
entrance	package.script	process	-	directory	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	resolved	src/sub/index.ts#	src/sub
entrance	package.script	process	-	emitted	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	resolved	src/main.ts#	dist/main
entrance	package.script	process	-	export	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	unresolved	not_indexed	scripts/export
entrance	package.script	process	-	absent	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	unresolved	not_found	scripts/absent
entrance	package.bin	process	-	app	exact	package.json:1
	target	startup	resolved	src/main.ts#	dist/main.js
